description: With the Cortina E-Common Integrated Family, your daily family adventures just got easier. Experience the convenience of an electric family bike that is fully tailored to your family life. No more worrying about a steering wheel that flips while you place your child in the front seat. Thanks to the stable central stand and the clever steering lock, your bike always stands securely and safely. And it's easy to attach using the MIK system in the front and the extra sturdy MIK HD on the rear. Two child seats, a large basket, and two panniers ensure that you can easily carry both your kids and your gear. How great is it that you can breeze past all the traffic and arrive at daycare on time without the stress of a traffic jam? With its smart design, practical solutions, and stylish look, the Cortina E-Common Integrated Family is a must-have for any mom, dad, grandpa, or grandma.
